sentence: This project studies what computers cannot do by using computer algorithms to prove lower bounds.
This project builds artificial intelligence tools that search for ceramic materials able to withstand extreme heat, wear, and harsh conditions.
This project explores the molecular and cellular basis of life through research on drug discovery, gene regulation, and structural biology.
This project tries to find out how many Cercospora species there are, which plants they infect, and which genetic features let them cause disease.
This project measures how much carbon is stored in peatlands and how hydroclimate patterns affect them.
This project studies how a specialized diet relates to extinction risk in mammals using the fossil record and records of ancient environments.
This project builds techniques that monitor network traffic and estimate how well the Internet performs for its users.
This project builds a device that tracks how mature stem cell-derived heart cells are and helps them mature using electric pulsing and mechanical stretching.
This project designs and makes hybrid molecules that recognize DNA sequences and tests whether they can stop transcription factors from binding to DNA.
This project builds a cooling instrument that uses liquid helium so a transmission electron microscope can take atomic images at extremely low temperatures.
This project describes the species of Protium, a group of tropical trees, and works out how they are related.
This project builds polymer nanoparticles that release their contents when oxygen is low and can be seen with ultrasound imaging.
This project builds a threat modeling framework and hands on labs about the risks of using artificial intelligence coding tools.
This project uses deep learning to predict the shapes of leaves from their gene expression profiles.
